+var environmentVariablePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\}$`)
+
+func environmentVariableHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(_ reflect.Kind, _ reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		value, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+		if !environmentVariablePattern.MatchString(value) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if replacement, ok := os.LookupEnv(value[2 : len(value)-1]); ok {
+			return replacement, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

+func TestEnvironmentVariableHookFunc(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION", "replaced")
+	hook := environmentVariableHookFunc()
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name  string
+		input any
+		want  any
+	}{
+		{"exact match", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "replaced"},
+		{"missing variable", "${FLIPT_TEST_MISSING_VARIABLE}", "${FLIPT_TEST_MISSING_VARIABLE}"},
+		{"prefix", "prefix${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "prefix${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
+		{"suffix", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}suffix", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}suffix"},
+		{"invalid first character", "${1INVALID}", "${1INVALID}"},
+		{"invalid character", "${INVALID-NAME}", "${INVALID-NAME}"},
+		{"named string type", LogEncoding("${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"), LogEncoding("${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}")},
+		{"non-string", 42, 42},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := mapstructure.DecodeHookExec(hook, reflect.ValueOf(tt.input), reflect.New(reflect.TypeOf(tt.input)).Elem())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}
+

+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")

+  grpc_port: ${FLIPT_TEST_GRPC_PORT}

+  encoding: ${FLIPT_TEST_LOG_ENCODING}
